title: Elbit Systems to Showcase Advanced Operational Capabilities at Marrakech Air Show 2026
body_markdown:
The company will showcase a broad range of advanced technologies and integrated operational capabilities designed to address evolving defense and security requirements.


Elbit Systems’ participation reflects its commitment to supporting its customers with advanced technologies and solutions tailored to evolving operational needs. Drawing on decades of technological expertise and operational experience supporting customers worldwide, the company delivers capabilities across multiple domains, integrating intelligence, sensors, autonomous platforms, communications, electronic warfare and precision effects.


At Marrakech Air Show 2026, Elbit Systems will showcase capabilities spanning unmanned and autonomous systems, precision fires, airborne protection and electronic warfare, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR), electro-optics, communications and digitalization, as well as advanced training and simulation.


The company's display will include the[Hermes™ 900](https://www.elbitsystems.com/autonomous/aerial/male-unmanned-aircraft-systems/hermes-900) Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) and **FUSE’s military-grade autonomous systems** designed for scalable deployment, including the[THOR](https://www.elbitsystems.com/networked-warfare/robotic-and-autonomous-solutions/tactical-unmanned-aerial-systems/thor) ,[Magni-X](https://www.elbitsystems.com/networked-warfare/robotic-and-autonomous-solutions/tactical-unmanned-aerial-systems/magni-x) and[FireFox-X](https://www.elbitsystems.com/networked-warfare/robotic-and-autonomous-solutions/tactical-unmanned-aerial-systems/firefox-x) families. Precision capabilities will include the[SkyStriker™](https://www.elbitsystems.com/autonomous/aerial/loitering-munition-systems/skystriker) loitering munition,[PULS™](https://www.elbitsystems.com/land/weapons-systems-and-munitions/launchers/puls) rocket artillery system and[LIZARD™](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/air-surface-munitions/missiles-rockets/lizard) laser-guided precision munition.


Elbit Systems will also showcase its portfolio of advanced airborne self-protection suites, including the[MINI MUSIC™](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/airborne-self-protection/dircm-systems/mini-music) Directed Infrared Countermeasure (DIRCM) system.


In the field of intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and electro-optics, Elbit Systems will present a range of advanced solutions, including the latest addition to its[SPECTRO™](https://www.elbitsystems.com/unmanned/maritime/usv-payloads/spectro) family of electro-optical payloads, the[SPECTRO™ 12](https://www.elbitsystems.com/air-space/airborne-c4isr/electro-optical-intelligence-systems/spectro-12) multispectral ISR and targeting payload.


Elbit Systems will showcase its advanced airborne communications and digitalization capabilities, alongside pilot training, simulation and flight school solutions designed to support operational readiness and aircrew proficiency.


Through continued investment in advanced technologies and innovation, Elbit Systems remains focused on developing solutions that address the evolving requirements of customers worldwide.
